ITA-9.6.11 nāḍīyantram नाडीयन्त्रम्
Tubular, scopic instruments
Tubular or scopic instrument with an opening at one end or both ends used for diagnostic and therapeutic procedures.

ITA-5.56.1 nāḍīvraṇaḥ नाडीव्रणः
Deep ulcer with fisula formation
A wound characterized by an excessive flow of pus; appearance of pus via a tubular pathway in vrana; discharge appearing from a tube. When a suppurated abscess goes untreated, pus accumulates in the affected area and enters skin, with muscle and blood tissues forming a tract owing to vitiated tridosha or each dosha separately.

ITA-9.2.42 nāḍīsvedaḥ नाडीस्वेदः
Sweating induced by steam directed from hose
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis of specific parts of the body is achieved by focused application of steam by means of tube.
